name: Extraction agent
role: Reads everything the migration needs from the Salesforce org: schema, business logic, security, reports, data, and an inventory of what stays in Salesforce.
outputs: adlc/1-discover/extraction/inventory/org.json, limits.json, currencies.json, files.json, attachments.json (org facts and volumes)
done_when: Every business object described, metadata and folder-based items retrieved, data exported with Salesforce IDs, gap register written
reviewer_checks: Object and row counts look complete
Objects that could not be exported are expected (system tables)
Gap register: each item has a route and an owner; client-input items are on the workshop agenda
Metadata types the org offers but the manifest does not request are reviewed (coverage.json)
